about: A security specialist focused on hardening systems before attackers find the gaps, with a steady record of leading detection and response efforts. Equally comfortable in a threat-modelling workshop and in the middle of a live incident. Believes good security is mostly good habits made repeatable.

experiences.description: Leads a security operations team responsible for detection engineering, incident response, and threat hunting across a global estate. Sets the security baseline and reviews architecture changes for exposure before release. Mentors analysts and runs post-incident reviews that feed back into stronger controls.

Built and tuned detection pipelines and led containment during high-severity incidents. Drove a programme to reduce standing access and enforce least-privilege across critical systems. Partnered with engineering teams to embed security checks into delivery pipelines.

Monitored alerts, investigated suspicious activity, and coordinated remediation with system owners. Conducted vulnerability assessments and tracked findings to closure. Authored internal guidance that raised baseline security awareness across teams.

Triaged security events and escalated genuine threats with clear evidence and timelines. Maintained and improved alerting rules to cut down on noise. Supported access reviews and routine control audits.

Assisted with log review and basic incident triage under senior supervision. Helped maintain asset inventories and patch-status reporting. Built foundational skills in threat detection and secure configuration.

Supported day-to-day security operations including account provisioning and firewall change reviews. Documented procedures and helped enforce policy compliance. Provided first-line response to reported security concerns.
